name: Jarvis Voice HeyGen Intro
description: Make one short Jarvis Voice promo from its public GitHub README: retain the research in Stash, generate a first-frame image, animate it with HeyGen, and link both in Canvas. Requires HEYGEN_API_KEY and a configured image provider. Each explicit run buys a new image and one 8-second 480p clip; inspect or collect an interrupted HeyGen job instead of rerunning.

steps.description: Check the optional HeyGen account before creating paid assets
steps.abort_speech: HeyGen is not configured or the account could not be checked. No generation was started.

steps.description: Read and retain the public GitHub README, without private Jarvis context
Provide the retained public project description to the image brief
Create and stash the original first-frame artwork
steps.abort_speech: The artwork did not finish. No HeyGen video was submitted. Check the image result before rerunning.

params.prompt: Animate the supplied Jarvis Voice first frame into an elegant 8-second open-source project introduction. Keep the exact JARVIS VOICE title and Your assistant. Your choice. line stable and readable; invent no extra writing. Slowly push the camera toward the waveform, add restrained jade light pulses and subtle panel parallax. No cuts, no new logos, no robots or people. Audio: a warm clear narrator says, "Jarvis Voice. Your assistant. Your choice. Voice, chat, and automation, on your terms." Quiet electronic ambience underneath, voice clearly above it. Do not add subtitles or claims about security or autonomy.

steps.description: Upload the Stash image and generate one short HeyGen clip
steps.abort_speech: The HeyGen video did not finish locally. Inspect its returned provider video ID and receipt, then use heygen status or collect. Rerunning this workflow starts another paid generation.
